<!-- Per GOVERNANCE.md, changes to keywords, syntax, data representation, the
     FFI, module resolution, or anything that breaks existing programs need a
     design proposal. It stays open at least 7 days before a decision. -->

## Ikibazo — The problem

<!-- What can't be done today, or what is awkward? Show real Wandaa code. -->

## Igitekerezo — The proposal

<!-- The change, concretely. Include the syntax and worked examples. -->

```wandaa
# before

# after
```

## Amazina mu Kinyarwanda — Kinyarwanda naming

<!-- If this adds a keyword or builtin: which Kinyarwanda word, and why is it
     the word a Kinyarwanda speaker would actually use for this concept?
     Transliterated English is not accepted -- see GOVERNANCE.md principle 1. -->

## Ingaruka — Impact

- Does this break existing `.waa` programs? If so, what is the migration path?
- Does this change how the compiler is built, or add a dependency?
- Does this affect the string or array representation?
- Which roadmap phase does it belong to?

## Ubundi buryo — Alternatives considered

<!-- What else could solve the problem, and why is this better? "I didn't
     consider any" is a reason to think longer before proposing. -->
